sentences.text: Junichi Hanzawa, born in 1965, graduated from the University of Tokyo's Faculty of Economics in 1988 and joined Mitsubishi Bank, now MUFG Bank, the same year.

He spent most of his career in planning and management functions, became president of MUFG Bank in April 2021, and after five years in that post took over as representative executive officer, president and Group CEO of the holding company in April 2026, having also served as chairman of the Japanese Bankers Association.
